svg.title: Relay Android home screen widgets
svg.desc: Promotional layout containing unmodified production Android RemoteViews renders: Work Time and Baby Time; a work timer with Interruption and End; a running interruption timer with Resume and End; and Baby 1, Baby 2, All babies. The widget controls use the current default colors and generic child labels. No personal home screen is shown.
svg.metadata: Source renders: /tmp/relay-widget-previews/idle-376x82.png; /tmp/relay-widget-interruption-previews/default-work-176x82.png; /tmp/relay-widget-interruption-previews/default-interrupted-blue-resume-176x82.png; /tmp/relay-widget-previews/picker-2-children-376x82.png. Captured from actual Relay RemoteViews on Android by the isolated WidgetPreviewInstrumentation / WidgetInterruptionSmokeInstrumentation harness. Widget images are embedded without pixel editing or recoloring. Canvas1170x2532. Fictional labels only.
svg.text: Start Work Time or Baby Time.
